Find every possible D-SEP set

Source: R/identification.R
possible_d_sep.Rd

Returns D-SEP(x, y, cg): every vertex other than x for which there is a collider path between x and the vertex in cg on which every vertex, including the vertex itself, is an ancestor of x or of some member of y. This is the plain graph-level primitive that backdoor_set() (for MAG/PAG) uses internally to build its generalized back-door set.

Usage

possible_d_sep(cg, x, y)

Arguments

cg

An AG-family (AG, MAG) or PAG graph created with cgraph().

x

Node name.

y

Node name, or character vector of node names.

Value

Sorted character vector of node names.

References

Maathuis MH, Colombo D (2015). “A generalized back-door criterion.” The Annals of Statistics, 43(3), 1060–1088.

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  mag <- cgraph(A %<->% X, A %-->% M, M %-->% Y, X %-->% Y, class = "MAG")
  list(
    possible_d_sep = possible_d_sep(mag, "X", "Y"),
    backdoor_set = backdoor_set(mag, "X", "Y") # M_X drops X --> Y
  )
}
#> $possible_d_sep
#> [1] "A" "M" "Y"
#> 
#> $backdoor_set
#> [1] "A"
#>
